finding: Reviewed category scores had free-text deduction rationale but no explicit machine-readable deduction count bound to the numeric score. That allowed prose deductions and awarded category points to become mathematically inconsistent without a dedicated fail-closed invariant.

staticChecks: exactly nine explicit integer deductionPoints values are required
score + deductionPoints == canonical category weight is enforced for every category
missing or legacy numeric arithmetic fails closed and requires re-review
the arithmetic QA awards zero Visual Fidelity points

expectedVisualScoreImpact.reason: Prevents mathematically inconsistent category awards and deductions from reaching the 92-point gate.

failureInjectionNextRunner: full-score category with deductionPoints=1 must fail
below-full category with deductionPoints=0 must fail
omitting deductionPoints from a full-score category must fail
non-integer deductionPoints such as 1.5 must fail explicit integer proof
legacy evidence without scoreArithmeticSchemaVersion must fail and require re-review
clean arithmetic packet may proceed only through the existing provenance, pixel-observability, temporal and numeric gates
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner plus actual native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing renders, 100% crops and temporal evidence.
